messages:
ara: Quick heads-up after testing the rotate flow in staging — found a handful of UX + accessibility friction points. Sharing notes so we can align on fixes. sophia (design): Thanks! Short list or screenshots? :eyes: ara: Short list here. I captured a gif but attaching separately. Issues: 1) The copy-to-clipboard toast overlays the one-time key drawer on small screens. 2) Screen readers don’t announce copy/reveal events. 3) After rotate users sometimes miss the single-show key because the CTA hierarchy is noisy. 4) Empty state for API keys duplicates org policy banner. mike (frontend): For (1) we render the snackbar bottom-left today. We can move it or render an inline confirmation. Which do you prefer? sophia (design): Inline confirmation next to the key feels more contextual — reduces visual jump. But global toasts are useful for cross-page messages. Proposal: move global toast to top-right; add a focused inline helper next to the key when revealed. lee (a11y): Regardless of placement, we need aria announcements. Current DOM flip doesn’t trigger AT. Add an aria-live region and explicit announcements for both success and failure paths. Also ensure focus management when the drawer opens (focus trap and focus on the key value) so keyboard users can copy easily. mike (frontend): Quick aria prototype suggestion: ```html
API key copied to clipboard
``` We can toggle innerText on success/failure. sam (security): Important security constraints: the plaintext key is single-show only. Any UI we add must not leak the secret after the drawer closes. That means: no persistent DOM nodes containing the plaintext, remove from history, and ensure clipboard handling doesn’t log contents. If we implement inline helpers, ensure they never contain the full token. ara: Design idea: single-show drawer that displays the key and two CTAs: "Copy" and "Download (.env)". After the user interacts (copy or download), replace the displayed plaintext with a masked summary (e.g., ****-e3f4) and show a soft banner: "This key will not be shown again. Store it securely." Optionally show a small checkbox "I saved this key" to encourage users to record it. lee (a11y): Checkbox is fine but don’t force it. For assistive tech, an extra required step can be a barrier. Better to keep Done enabled immediately, but include aria-describedby on the checkbox to explain purpose. Also focus order: after reveal, move focus to the Copy button, and provide a clear skip link for screen reader users to move to download. mike (frontend): Implementation notes from my side: - Add a visually-hidden aria-live region for copy/reveal events. - Move global snackbar to top-right so it doesn’t overlap the drawer on narrow viewports. - Implement inline confirmation (non-persistent) next to key row for contextual feedback. - Remove plaintext from DOM after action/timeout. Use a mutation observer to verify removal and replace with masked summary. sam (security): Don’t rely only on client-side timers. If the user leaves the page or JS crashes, ensure the server never re-sends plaintext and that session memory is cleared on unmount. Also run a quick audit to ensure clipboard API usage isn’t recorded by logging middleware. ara: One more: the existing empty state shows both a large CTA and a huge org-policy banner stacked. It’s visually heavy and duplicates info. Suggest compacting: primary CTA plus a small inline note about org rotation policy with a link to full settings. sophia (design): Agreed. Updated mock: primary Create key button centered, small policy line below: "Organization rotation policy active — keys rotate every 90 days. Learn more." Keep the banner only on settings pages. lee (a11y): For the empty state, ensure semantic markup (main, h1/h2), keyboard focus lands on the primary CTA on navigation, and when policy status toggles, announce changes via aria-live. ops-bot: deploy:staging started for branch keys/rotate-a11y-fixes by @mike at 2024-05-02T16:12:00Z mike (frontend): I’ll open a PR with these changes: aria-live region, global toast reposition, inline confirmation, DOM cleanup for plaintext, and empty state layout tweak. Will add unit tests for copy success/fail and an e2e for reveal + failed clipboard path. ara: Please also add an integration test that asserts the plaintext is removed from the DOM after action and that the masked summary is shown. sam (security): I’ll run a quick security checklist against staging once PR is in. Also confirm we don’t expose secrets in Sentry breadcrumbs or analytics events. sophia (design): I’ll update the spec doc with the final microcopy: - Copy success: "API key copied to clipboard." - Copy failure: "Copy failed. Please download or try again." - Single-show banner: "This key will not be shown again. Store it securely." lee (a11y): I’ll draft the a11y checklist for the PR review (focus order, aria-live, announcements, readable contrast for banners). ara: Thanks team — this should close most of the UX nits we saw. Ping here when staging is up and I’ll validate. :white_check_mark:
